theme: Mutual fund literacy: what is an expense ratio, active vs passive, fund categories
headline: Understanding Expense Ratios in Mutual Funds
body: Expense ratios are annual costs charged by fund managers for managing your investments. Lower ratios mean more of your money stays invested.
caption: Every mutual fund charges fees to cover operational costs. These expenses are expressed as a percentage of assets under management. Active funds typically charge higher fees due to frequent trading, while passive funds tracking indices generally have lower costs. Knowing these differences helps you make informed choices. #MutualFundLiteracy #ExpenseRatio #InvestmentCosts #ActiveVsPassive #SmartInvesting
